memos.scout:
Case for buying: the last 15 minutes show real two-sided activity, 2,604 buyers against 1,063 sellers and 993 SOL bought versus 949 SOL sold, with net inflow of 44 SOL. Price is still up 37% over that window, and the 30-minute return is positive at 9%. The coin is alive, classed ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump seen, and the buyer base is broad, with the top 5 buyers holding only 26% of early volume. Pool depth of 163 SOL can absorb a $20 round trip with modest impact.

The honest counterpoint is serious, though. The curve shows bundle_share of 1.0 and top-3 share of 87%, the launch bot was present, and the price is 45% off its 30-minute high, which is a sharp reversal after a spike. A sell-to-buy ratio of 0.81 in the first minutes says early holders were already exiting. Those signals undercut the "demand will persist" thesis. The "ORGANIC" label and the 2,604-buyer count are the strongest evidence for the bull case, but they don't outweigh the bundling and the drawdown. I would not recommend a buy at this moment.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: insider distribution after a sharp drawdown. The coin is 44.65% off its 30-minute high, yet the last 15 minutes show 993.5 SOL bought against 949.4 SOL sold, with sellers (1,063) outnumbering nothing but still heavy, and net flow only +44 SOL. Sell-to-buy in the first two minutes after graduation was 0.81, and the curve shows bundle_share 1.0 with top-3 holders at 87%, so a few wallets likely hold most supply and can exit into any bounce. Pool depth of 163 SOL means a $20 round trip costs 1.4-5.1% before any move, and a 30-second fill lag lets the next leg down happen first. The 0.3686 15-minute return is a bounce off the low, not a trend, so the odds favor a fade.
